standards.description: Analyse text structures and language features and evaluate their effectiveness in achieving their purpose
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students analyse text structures and language features and evaluate their effectiveness.

standards.title: Paragraph structure and image integration
standards.description: Understand how paragraph structure can be varied to create cohesion, and paragraphs and images can be integrated for different purposes
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students understand how varied paragraph structure and image integration create cohesion for different purposes.

standards.title: Sentence structures for effect
standards.description: Analyse and evaluate the effectiveness of particular sentence structures to express and craft ideas
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students analyse and evaluate how sentence structures express and craft ideas effectively.

standards.title: Syntax and style
standards.description: Analyse how meaning and style are achieved through syntax
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students analyse how syntax achieves meaning and style.

standards.title: Evaluate visual features and representations
standards.description: Evaluate the features of still and moving images, and the effects of those choices on representations
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students evaluate how features of still and moving images affect representations.

standards.title: Academic vocabulary for precision
standards.description: Use an expanded technical and academic vocabulary for precision when writing academic texts
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students use expanded technical and academic vocabulary for precision in academic writing.

standards.title: Punctuation experimentation
standards.description: Understand how authors use and experiment with punctuation
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students understand how authors use and experiment with punctuation for effect.

standards.title: Manipulate spelling for effect
standards.description: Use knowledge of the spelling system to spell words and to manipulate standard spelling for particular effects
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students use spelling system knowledge to spell accurately and manipulate spelling deliberately for stylistic effect.

standards.title: Evaluate representations and contexts
standards.description: Analyse and evaluate how people, places, events and concepts are represented in texts and reflect contexts
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students analyse and evaluate how representations in texts reflect and are shaped by their contexts.

standards.title: Explain text structure effects
standards.description: Listen to spoken texts and explain the purposes and effects of text structures and language features, and use interaction skills to discuss and present an opinion about these texts
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students explain how text structures and language features achieve effects and use interaction skills to present opinions.

standards.title: Evaluate implicit values and beliefs
standards.description: Analyse and evaluate how language features are used to implicitly or explicitly represent values, beliefs and attitudes
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students analyse and evaluate how language implicitly and explicitly represents values, beliefs and attitudes.

standards.title: Evaluate authorial organisation
standards.description: Analyse and evaluate how authors organise ideas in texts to achieve a purpose
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students analyse and evaluate how authors organise ideas to achieve specific purposes.

standards.title: Interpret complex and abstract ideas
standards.description: Integrate comprehension strategies such as visualising, predicting, connecting, summarising, monitoring, questioning and inferring to analyse and interpret complex and abstract ideas
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students integrate comprehension strategies to analyse and interpret complex and abstract ideas across texts.

standards.title: Experiment with text for effect
standards.description: Plan, create, edit and publish written and multimodal texts, organising, expanding and developing ideas through experimenting with text structures, language features, literary devices and multimodal features for specific purposes and audiences in ways that may be imaginative, reflective, informative, persuasive, analytical and/or critical
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students plan, create and publish texts experimenting with structures and devices for specific purposes and audiences.

standards.title: Use rhetoric to engage audiences
standards.description: Plan, create, rehearse and deliver spoken and multimodal presentations by experimenting with rhetorical devices, and the organisation and development of ideas, to engage audiences for different purposes in ways that may be imaginative, reflective, informative, persuasive, analytical and/or critical
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students plan, create and deliver presentations experimenting with rhetorical devices to engage audiences for diverse purposes.

standards.title: Evaluate representations and context
standards.description: Analyse representations of individuals, groups and places and evaluate how they reflect their context in literary texts by First Nations Australian, and wide-ranging Australian and world authors
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students analyse and evaluate how representations of individuals, groups and places reflect their context in literary texts.

standards.title: Extend others' interpretations
standards.description: Reflect on and extend others' interpretations of and responses to literature
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students reflect on and extend others' interpretations of and responses to literature.

standards.title: Aesthetic qualities and audience response
standards.description: Analyse how the aesthetic qualities associated with text structures, language features, literary devices and visual features, and the context in which these texts are experienced, influence audience response
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students analyse how aesthetic qualities and context influence audience response to literary texts.

standards.title: Evaluate ethical positions
standards.description: Evaluate the social, moral or ethical positions represented in literature
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students evaluate the social, moral and ethical positions represented in literature.

standards.title: Intertextual connections shape meaning
standards.description: Analyse how text structure, language features, literary devices and intertextual connections shape interpretations of texts
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students analyse how text structures, literary devices and intertextual connections shape interpretations.

standards.title: Voice across text types
standards.description: Compare and evaluate how 'voice' as a literary device is used in different types of texts, such as poetry, novels and film, to evoke emotional responses
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students compare and evaluate how voice as a literary device evokes emotional responses across text types.

standards.title: Evaluate aesthetic qualities
standards.description: Analyse and evaluate the aesthetic qualities of texts
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students analyse and evaluate the aesthetic qualities of literary texts.

standards.title: Create with sustained voice
standards.description: Create and edit literary texts with a sustained 'voice', selecting and adapting text structures, literary devices, and language, auditory and visual features for purposes and audiences
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students create and edit literary texts with a sustained voice, selecting and adapting structures, devices and features for purposes and audiences.

standards.title: Language use at home and school
standards.description: Explore how language is used differently at home and school depending on the relationships between people
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students explore how language use differs between home and school contexts depending on relationships.

standards.title: Language to express preferences
standards.description: Explore different ways of using language to express preferences, likes and dislikes
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students explore different ways language is used to express preferences, likes and dislikes.

standards.title: Texts take many forms
standards.description: Understand that texts can take many forms such as signs, books and digital texts
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students understand that texts exist in many forms including signs, books and digital texts.

standards.title: Conventions of print and screen
standards.description: Understand conventions of print and screen, including how books and simple digital texts are usually organised
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students understand conventions of print and screen and how books and digital texts are organised.

standards.title: Sentences express ideas
standards.description: Recognise that sentences are key units for expressing ideas
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students recognise that sentences are key units for expressing ideas.

standards.title: Words work together in sentences
standards.description: Recognise that sentences are made up of groups of words that work together in particular ways to make meaning
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students recognise that sentences are made up of word groups that work together to make meaning.

standards.title: Images and words make meaning
standards.description: Explore the contribution of images and words to meaning in stories and informative texts
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students explore how images and words together contribute to meaning in texts.

standards.title: Vocabulary in familiar contexts
standards.description: Recognise and develop awareness of vocabulary used in familiar contexts related to everyday experiences, personal interests and topics taught at school
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students recognise vocabulary used in familiar everyday and school contexts.

standards.title: Punctuation and capital letters
standards.description: Identify punctuation as a feature of written text different from letters; recognise that capital letters are used for names, and that capital letters also signal the beginning of sentences while punctuation marks signal the end
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students identify punctuation as distinct from letters and recognise how capital letters and punctuation signal sentence boundaries.

standards.title: Recognise rhyme and phonemes
standards.description: Recognise and generate rhyming words, alliteration patterns, syllables and sounds (phonemes) in spoken words (phonological awareness)
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students recognise and generate rhyming words, alliteration patterns, syllables and phonemes in spoken words.

standards.title: Segment and blend phonemes
standards.description: Segment sentences into individual words; orally blend and segment single-syllable spoken words; isolate, blend and manipulate phonemes in single-syllable words (phonological awareness)
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students segment sentences into words and blend and manipulate phonemes in single-syllable spoken words.

standards.title: Name letters and common sounds
standards.description: Recognise and name all upper- and lower-case letters (graphs) and know the most common sound that each letter represents
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students recognise and name all upper- and lower-case letters and identify the most common sound each represents.

standards.title: Write and read CVC words
standards.description: Write consonant-vowel-consonant (CVC) words by representing sounds with the appropriate letters, and blend sounds associated with letters when reading CVC words
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students write CVC words by matching sounds to letters and blend letter sounds when reading CVC words.

standards.title: Use letters and sounds to spell
standards.description: Use knowledge of letters and sounds to spell words
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students use knowledge of letters and sounds to spell words.

standards.title: Read and write high-frequency words
standards.description: Read and write some high-frequency words and other familiar words
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students read and write some high-frequency and familiar words.

standards.title: Words as units of meaning
standards.description: Understand that words are units of meaning and can be made of more than one meaningful part
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students understand that words are units of meaning and can contain more than one meaningful part.

standards.title: Identify familiar texts and purpose
standards.description: Identify some familiar texts, such as stories and informative texts, and their purpose
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students identify some familiar texts and their purpose.

standards.title: Listen and use voice features
standards.description: Interact in informal and structured situations by listening while others speak and using features of voice including volume levels
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students interact in informal and structured situations by listening while others speak and using voice features such as volume.

standards.title: Differences between text types
standards.description: Identify some differences between imaginative and informative texts
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students identify some differences between imaginative and informative texts.

standards.title: Read using phonic knowledge
standards.description: Read decodable and authentic texts using developing phonic knowledge, and monitor meaning using context and emerging grammatical knowledge
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students read decodable and authentic texts using developing phonic knowledge, monitoring meaning with context and grammar.

standards.title: Use comprehension strategies
standards.description: Use comprehension strategies such as visualising, predicting, connecting, summarising and questioning to understand and discuss texts listened to, viewed or read independently
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students use comprehension strategies including visualising, predicting and questioning to understand and discuss texts.

standards.title: Create short written texts
standards.description: Create and participate in shared editing of short written texts to record and report ideas and events using some learnt vocabulary, basic sentence boundary punctuation and spelling some consonant-vowel-consonant words correctly
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students create and help edit short written texts to record ideas and events using learnt vocabulary and basic punctuation.

standards.title: Deliver short spoken texts
standards.description: Create and deliver short spoken texts to report ideas and events to peers, using features of voice such as appropriate volume
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students create and deliver short spoken texts to report ideas and events using appropriate volume.

standards.title: Share ideas about literature
standards.description: Share ideas about stories, poems and images in literature, reflecting on experiences that are similar or different to their own by engaging with texts by First Nations Australian, and wide-ranging Australian and world authors and illustrators
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students share ideas about stories, poems and images, reflecting on experiences similar or different to their own.

standards.title: Respond to stories and characters
standards.description: Respond to stories and share feelings and thoughts about their events and characters
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students respond to stories and share feelings and thoughts about events and characters.

standards.title: Recognise literary text types
standards.description: Recognise different types of literary texts and identify features including events, characters, and beginnings and endings
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students recognise different literary text types and identify features including events, characters and structure.

standards.title: Explore rhythms and sound patterns
standards.description: Explore and replicate the rhythms and sound patterns of literary texts such as poems, rhymes and songs
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students explore and replicate rhythms and sound patterns in poems, rhymes and songs.

standards.title: Retell and adapt familiar texts
standards.description: Retell and adapt familiar literary texts through play, performance, images or writing
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students retell and adapt familiar literary texts through play, performance, images or writing.

expressing_ideas.label: Language for expressing and developing ideas

engaging_responding.label: Engaging with and responding to literature
